source_agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Army Geospatial Center
source_title: USACE IENC Master Service — PIPE_AREA layer
retention: Exact response bytes staged under raw/source.geojson and copied unchanged to geojson/source.geojson; source receipt stored under metadata/source_receipt.json.
completeness: The service reports 112 PIPE_AREA records; the full object-ID roster is queried independently and must match every GeoJSON feature. The 112-ID roster is pinned; count, ID, schema, geometry, and duplicate Feature_ID drift fails before staging.
lineage_limit: The HIFLD catalog describes an archived USACE IENC-derived layer and reports 7,260 miles across 21 rivers. The current USACE master service says it contains all IENC vector data, but its equivalence to the archived HIFLD Pipeline Areas snapshot, the original extraction rules, and currency of the underlying pipeline surveys are not established. Do not treat its latest service timestamp as a survey date.
decision: Draft extraction is technically complete for the current USACE master PIPE_AREA layer. Dataset acceptance remains pending maintainer confirmation that the HIFLD inventory item maps to this current layer and that the pipeline-area semantics match the requested dataset.
